name: John Kennedy

issue_poll.name: LSU Reilly Center 2022 Louisiana Survey, Feb 21 – Mar 21, 2022
issue_poll.note: Single most important problem facing Louisiana; residents, not likely voters; fielded eight months before Election Day. No ranked fall 2022 Louisiana issue poll found. Economy/education tie and 2% ties ordered as listed in the report.

issues.position: Blamed federal spending for inflation; no specific plan

issues.note: Campaign K-12 message was parents' rights only (slogan); rated on student loans.

issues.position: Spend less; people should keep most of what they earn
issues.note: Campaign cited past votes against spending and for 2017 tax cuts, not forward pledges.

issues.position: Cap insulin prices; lower prescription drug costs
issues.note: No Senate floor roll call on an insulin price cap this term found.

issues.position: No new federal gun control laws

votes.bill_title: Disapproval of ATF pistol brace rule
votes.question: On the joint resolution

issues.position: Halt FEMA's Risk Rating 2.0 flood insurance pricing
issues.note: No floor vote on halting or capping Risk Rating 2.0; NFIP extended in funding bills.

issues.position: Cited past disaster aid secured; no forward pledge

caveats: Issue ranking uses a spring 2022 poll of Louisiana residents on state problems; no fall 2022 voter issue poll found, so national issues (immigration, abortion) are absent.
Kennedy's 2022 campaign ran mostly on record and slogans; few forward-looking specifics found, so half the issues are not testable.
Education rated on student loan cancellation, a judgment call; Insurance rated on flood insurance (Risk Rating 2.0) as the federal angle.
Roll calls 127 (2025, via thelobbynews) and 171 (2023, via usquery) and Kennedy's Yea votes on them come from third-party trackers; 135 confirmed in the Congressional Record.
